name: devstarter
description: Start any project in a few clicks, even if you have never programmed: pick an idea (3D website, game, blog, app…) or a stack (React, Next.js, Express, FastAPI, Laravel…). Adds databases, 54 libraries with live demos, Docker and CI, installs and updates your tools, and keeps your project libraries up to date.

enumDescriptions: More explanations, welcome pages and a GETTING_STARTED guide
Compact wizard, commands shown as they run
devstarter.experienceLevel.description: How DevStarter talks to you. Leave empty to be asked the first time.

devstarter.defaultPackageManager.description: Package manager selected by default for JavaScript projects.

devstarter.initGit.description: Create a Git repository with a first commit by default.

devstarter.showLiveLogs.description: Show the full output of every command while the project is being created (press 'v' in the DevStarter terminal to toggle).

devstarter.startDevServerOnOpen.description: Start the development server automatically when a newly created project is opened.

devstarter.showStatusBarButton.description: Show the "New Project" button in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Open the app in your default browser
Open the app inside VS Code (Simple Browser)
devstarter.openBrowser.description: When the dev server is ready, open the app automatically.

devstarter.scaffolderVersions.markdownDescription: Pin the version of a project generator if the latest one breaks, e.g. `{ "@angular/cli": "21", "create-vite": "7" }`. Generators not listed use `latest`.

enumDescriptions: Open the project and start the frontend and backend servers automatically (a new window if a folder is already open)
devstarter.afterCreate.description: What to do when the project is ready.

viewsWelcome.contents:
New to coding? Create a ready-to-run project in a few clicks.
[$(sparkle) New Project with DevStarter](command:devstarter.newProject)
[$(tools) Check & update my tools](command:devstarter.checkTools)

walkthroughs.title: Start your first project with DevStarter
walkthroughs.description: From zero to a running app in a couple of minutes.

steps.title: Check your tools
steps.description:
See what is installed on your computer. DevStarter can install Node.js, Git, Python and more for you.
[$(tools) Check my tools](command:devstarter.checkTools)

steps.title: Create a project
steps.description:
Pick what you want to build, and DevStarter installs and configures everything.
[$(sparkle) New Project](command:devstarter.newProject)

steps.title: Not sure? Try React
steps.description:
React with Vite and Tailwind CSS is a great first stack.
[Create a React project](command:devstarter.newProject?%5B%22react%22%5D)

steps.title: Run it and make changes
steps.description:
Your project opens with the dev server running and a GETTING_STARTED.md guide.
[$(book) Open the guide](command:devstarter.openGuide)

scripts.compile: pnpm check-types && pnpm lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: pnpm check-types && pnpm lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: pnpm compile-tests && pnpm compile && pnpm lint
